name: usb-net
description: Universal ASIX USB-Ethernet driver for PCM 3.1 / MMI3G+ / RNS-850. Supports AX88772 / 772A / 772B / 772C (and 88178 + Linksys/NetGear rebadges) by activating Harman's own AX88772B init path from later firmware. Brings up the link, gets DHCP (or your static address), sets up internet (default route + DNS) when there is a gateway, and enables telnet. 'This session only' loads from USB and never modifies the firmware: a restart undoes it. 'Every boot' (beta, PCM 3.1) also keeps the network and telnet after every restart with no stick, by adding a few small files to /HBpersistence; 'Remove the boot setup' takes them out again.
author: dspl1236

values.label: Auto adapter · DHCP
values.group: Every boot — stays after a restart (beta, PCM 3.1)
values.note: Every boot adds a few small files to /HBpersistence (never the firmware) and leaves telnet (port 23) and a root shell (port 2323) open, with no password, on whatever network the adapter is plugged into, after every restart. Only use it on a network you trust. Plug the adapter in while the stick runs (a USB hub works), or run the stick alone, then plug the adapter in and restart. To undo it, build a stick with Remove the boot setup.

values.label: Remove the boot setup
values.note: Takes the Every boot files out of /HBpersistence and puts the PCM's own settings back the way they were. After the next restart, no network or telnet unless you run a stick.
